reviewed_by: Codex focused review of search and Work read admission; independent root-cause validation by validate_load_cause
reason: Search and Work read-only HTTP handlers must not block unrelated operator requests under concurrent load. Validate six read/filter entry points, mixed 24-request cancellation retaining physical reader capacity, worker failure recovery, existing search scope/pagination/privacy/stale-index/cursor behavior, and Work ownership/auth/durable refresh and source-chat filters. Disposable paired LAN Core load compares 1/8/32/64 clients against 12000 synthetic notes and 2000 tasks. Extended selection: search action lookup cost must stay constant with page size and batch guards must retain ownership, existence, revision and device capability checks. Concurrent HTTP and separate Butler search services must repair once, preserve newer edits and deletions, and keep private chat filtering and digest-bound chunks. Candidate projection fields are read as scalar rows to avoid ORM hydration while retaining the same 2000-candidate bound and sorting.
exclusions: Backend scheduling and search projection/action lookup only; response schemas, search ranking/query semantics, mutation API contracts, interface controls, native code, provider/harness execution and origin policy are unchanged. No frontend/native/Playwright tests apply to this read boundary; browser/layout/device matrix excluded. No full suites, live external services, production data or running Core replacement.
